answer: In PoA, each interaction contributes a decayed signal to the EigenTrust matrix: reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, mutually validated honest service to retain weight. A freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality; without trusted paths or reciprocal support, it cannot influence consensus, however cleverly it imitates a sonnet or hides behind a ledge.
